newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends slightly up vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends slightly up vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up slightly at 8.2932 on Friday from Thursday's 8.2935 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on a technical rebound, traders said.
The weighted average price on Thursday was 8.2935.
Dealers said the yuan rebounded on Friday after falling sharply on Thursday but market sentiment remained cautious with investors waiting for Beijing to announce foreign trade data for May.
The yuan opened slightly lower at 8.2937 and moved in a range of 8.2935 and an intraday low of 8.2940 early in trading.
